chunks: Ibn al-Mutawakkil, from Ali, from his father, from al-Rayyan ibn al-Salt, from Ali ibn Musa al-Rida, from his forefathers, from the Commander of the Faithful (peace be upon him) who said:
The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: Allah, Majestic is His Majesty, said: He has not believed in Me the one who interprets My words based on his opinion.

key_terms.أَمِيرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ: Commander of the Faithful (Ali ibn Abi Talib)

ai.seo_question: What does it mean to interpret God's words based on one's own opinion in Shia theology?
ai.summary: This hadith, traced through the Ahl al-Bayt chain, warns that relying solely on personal opinion (ra'y) to interpret the Quran can lead to misguidance, a key concept in Shia usul al-fiqh regarding the limits of individual reasoning versus authoritative exegesis. It underscores the necessity of grounding interpretation in divine revelation and the teachings of the Imams to ensure true faith.
